description: An EXTENDED LETTER as a character of a COBOL word — ISO §2023:8.3.2.1: "Each character of a COBOL word … shall be selected from the set of basic letters, basic digits, extended letters, and the basic special characters hyphen and underscore", with §2023:8.1.3.2 GR4 making the extended letters the Annex B repertoire less the basic characters (Annex A.4.6, claimed). A COBOL-2002 introduction: the '85 word character set is the basic letters, digits and hyphen. Lexed at EVERY edition (superset-lex / bind-narrow) so the below-2002 rejection is this named gate rather than a lexical error; from 2002 the Annex B position rules are COBOL2773. kb/Work PB1402.
display: an extended letter in a COBOL word
citation: ISO §2023:8.3.2.1 (word character set: basic letters, basic digits, extended letters, hyphen, underscore); §2023:8.1.3.2 GR4; Annex B — 2002 introduction, the '85 set having no extended letters
vcr: 2002 introduction (derive from the 2002 standard); the Annex B repertoire then changed 2014->2023 per E.2 item 4 and E.3.3 items 4/5 (VCR row 10, CobolCharacterRepertoire)
